commit ad99f1ea3a43f5b556640fff065d8900b0f15307
Author: Bjynt <Bjynt@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Thu Sep 10 13:17:20 2026 +0100

    fix(auditor): prompt-only dispatches must not hash an undefined goalRevision key
    
    Live loop audits failed with 'auditor worker exited without an atomic
    result' (no-verdict): the request literal carried
    'goalRevision: capturedRevisionToken' unconditionally. For prompt-only
    (loop) dispatches the token is undefined — stableJson hashes the key
    (Object.keys includes undefined-valued keys, serialized as the text
    'undefined') while JSON.stringify drops it on disk, so the stored
    requestHash can never verify against the on-disk bytes and the worker
    exits at identity() before spawning pi. Goal audits were unaffected
    (their token is always defined), which is why only loop audits failed.
    
    Fix: include goalRevision conditionally (same pattern as inspection /
    auditSubject / allowedExtensions — present only when known, so every
    existing request shape stays byte-identical).
    
    Regression test: on-disk request.json must self-verify via the exported
    requestHash for BOTH goal-shaped and prompt-shaped dispatches.
